system_hypothesis.claim: Expensive intelligence and human demonstrations can be compiled into cheaper, verified, replayable execution without increasing unsupported claims.
system_hypothesis.test: Run the matched before/after protocol in bench/beast-loop-protocol.json across materially different domains.

capabilities.name: Source-linked tutorial video acquisition
capabilities.claim: Adaptive video ingestion retains timestamped frames, transcript segments, source metadata, and targeted reinspection history.
capabilities.boundary: Sparse retained frames are not continuous video understanding.
capabilities.next_test: Measure recovery accuracy on a frozen set of visually ambiguous procedures.

capabilities.name: Tutorial evidence to executed procedure
capabilities.claim: Tutorial evidence has been compiled and executed in retained Unreal Engine proof cases.
capabilities.boundary: The result is not generalized to arbitrary tutorials, sites, applications, or engine versions.
capabilities.next_test: Run the frozen cross-domain Beast-loop benchmark with matched direct and compiled execution.

capabilities.name: Hash-bound media evidence and promotion custody
capabilities.claim: Exact media bytes can be admitted under bounded authorization, converted from Watch v3 into source-time evidence, linked to claims and fresh execution receipts, and promoted only when every runtime gate passes.
capabilities.boundary: One repaired silent-tutorial execution does not prove arbitrary-media understanding; Google Cloud Vision transport is contract-tested but has not been called live in this proof; research authorization is not dataset-training permission.
capabilities.next_test: Run the same frozen contracts on an owned image with an explicitly authorized live SafeSearch and Web Detection call, then independently review every returned evidence boundary.

capabilities.name: Official Unreal Engine 5.8 MCP control
capabilities.claim: The official UE 5.8 MCP can inspect and mutate a disposable project with retained receipts.
capabilities.boundary: A working control plane does not prove that every Unreal workflow is automatable or correct.
capabilities.next_test: Benchmark whole-graph operations against node-by-node construction on identical tasks.

capabilities.name: iPhone Live Link Face to assembled MetaHuman
capabilities.claim: A UE 5.8 MetaHuman was assembled, bound to Live Link Face, and practical facial reproduction was retained through independent curve and image evidence.
capabilities.boundary: The rejected strict DEFORMATION_MEASURED gate is not silently promoted, and production readiness is not established.
capabilities.next_test: Repeat the frozen capture protocol on a materially different character and lighting setup.

capabilities.name: Atomic crash recovery checkpoint
capabilities.claim: A secret-free atomic checkpoint records Git state, next actions, target environment, and hashed evidence, and can be verified before resume.
capabilities.boundary: A checkpoint cannot preserve unsaved third-party application state unless that state is separately saved and cited.
capabilities.next_test: Kill and resume a long external workflow from the last verified checkpoint without repeating a completed paid or cloud step.

capabilities.name: Durable internal GPU leases
capabilities.claim: Beast Studio serializes heavy workloads, bounds light concurrency, reclaims stale leases, and observes cancellation and deadlines.
capabilities.boundary: Internal leases alone cannot prevent unrelated desktop applications from consuming VRAM.
capabilities.next_test: Exercise external VRAM admission while Unreal and an Ollama model are independently active.

capabilities.name: External-aware GPU admission
capabilities.claim: Before a Beast GPU lease is granted, live NVIDIA memory pressure is compared with a workload budget and a protected reserve.
capabilities.boundary: Admission is a point-in-time guard and cannot stop another desktop process from allocating VRAM afterward.
capabilities.next_test: Retain three real admission decisions under idle, Unreal-active, and Ollama-active conditions.

capabilities.name: Evidence-scoped cross-session reflection
capabilities.claim: Repository-scoped session and proof evidence can be reduced into a bounded, redacted review bundle with freshness and exclusion receipts.
capabilities.boundary: Collection does not prove that a proposed change improves later agent performance.
capabilities.next_test: Run the predeclared five-task before/after replay after approved proposals.
